custom_logic_notes: The 'Three Typical Candles' pattern requires a specific candlestick body-to-wick ratio: the body must exceed 50% of the total candle range, and the opposite-side wick must be less than 30% of the total range. This identifies a strong directional candle with minimal rejection. All indicator checks use bar[1] (previous completed bar) values, never bar[0]. The EA uses a digit-adjustment pattern where SL/TP in points are multiplied by 10 when the broker uses 5-digit (3-digit for JPY) pricing. Signal reversal logic: if an opposite signal is detected while a position is open, the existing position is closed first, then a new position in the opposite direction may be opened on the same bar.
python_conversion_notes: The candle pattern logic (body > 50% of range, opposite wick < 30% of range) is straightforward to implement in pandas. EMA crossover with RSI and MACD confirmation uses standard ta-lib or pandas-ta functions. Key detail: all signal checks use previous bar (shift=1 in Python), not current bar. The digit adjustment logic (multiplying SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be handled by detecting the symbol's point size at initialization. The new_bar guard must be implemented to prevent multiple entries per bar. Spread filter check should be done at signal time using current ask-bid difference.
